original_card.acceptance_gate: State which fixed-alphabet premise changes and charge its implementation; do not declare it free. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

original_card.bottleneck_link: A new legal connector operation could change recursive interface cost; a larger census in the same alphabet is a separate side result.
allowed_variations: Choose one additional operation and a small source count for its first counterexample.
scope_change_triggers: Keeping the alphabet and only increasing the source count; record this as a changed assignment.
Extending a source-count census without naming a supplier/interface decision it could change; audit #2973 pruning concerns before relying on the affected predecessor exclusions.

actual_scope: Exact complete-call tariff for a generic d-linear F2 operation evaluated only on independently dirty borrowed input rows, with source toggles and restoration. Construct a weighted cube word and prove an all-word lower bound.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for one additional priced operation. The new operation is a separately linear evaluation on several borrowed inputs, beyond the original linear one-connector alphabet. This is an abstract interface result, not a physical supplier claim.
bottleneck_link: A changed nonlinear query boundary must price all source acquisition and borrowed-row restoration. The exact exponential generic price prevents a nonlinear black box from being treated as a free escape from the current caller budget; no selected occurrence or favorable signed moment is claimed.
stop_rule: Ship the first verified strict word improvement, with the already derived weighted formula and matching lower bound; do not search for a supplier or extend the operation alphabet.
evidence: Scoped proof in PROOF.md; verify.py enumerates 276 read-parity vectors, 2728 scalar dirty states, 65536 matrix source/dirt tuples and 84 exact shortest-walk price contexts settling 25948 states. Nineteen stated controls pass. Direct normal/optimized and registered checks pass locally. No native supplier, new kappa or proof-kernel claim.
